steps.text: Hey 😊 I owe you a container lid. Somehow I've managed to bring that home as well 😭
Is that your way of arranging another visit?
No 😌 I was going to do that without stealing your kitchen
You already left a spoon here. We could call it an exchange
A very domestic hostage situation 😭
I'll keep it safe
Thank you ❤️ I'll text you properly before I go to sleep 😊
A LITTLE LATER, AT HOME
{{name:player}}?
Yes. I accidentally brought home his container lid
You two are going to need an inventory
He has my spoon. We're negotiating
I could mediate
You disputed a score displayed in numbers. I don't think you're qualified
Do you want sugar?
One, please
See? A preference. Very impressive
You saved that one all the way from yesterday
I've been waiting for the right moment
AFTER THEY SIT DOWN WITH THEIR TEA
This is much nicer than shouting over a machine
You were the one doing most of the shouting
I got involved
You explained your strategy to a puck
And it refused to listen
I had a nice evening
So did I
I'm not only saying that because I won
I know
You get easier to talk to when you stop trying to win the conversation as well
I wasn't aware there were points for that
You'd find some
All right. No points tonight
Don't say it like you're doing me a favor
I'm not. I'm enjoying sitting here
Me too
Cold?
Only my hands
There's a blanket beside you
I know. Your arm is in the way
Should I move it?
Not that way. Here

steps.title: HAK//NOTICE
messages: {{name:lena}} moves onto his lap side of the sofa
His hand settles at her waist under the blanket

messages.speaker: player
messages.text: They're getting closer, and I need to notice my own limits as well as respect hers.

steps.text: Better?
Yes. Stay there. Your hand can stay too
I can do that
You're tracing the edge of my top like you're asking permission
I am asking
You already have it. Come here
Here?
You know what I mean

steps.title: HAK//NOTICE
messages: {{name:lena}} pulls him into a longer kiss
His hand slides under her top along her back

steps.text: Don't stop just because I made a noise
That wasn't a complaint
It wasn't. Higher. No — there
Your tea is going to go cold
Put the cup down. Carefully. Then come back

steps.title: HAK//NOTICE
messages: His mouth at her neck, her fingers in his hair

steps.text: Tell me if that's too much
It's not. I wanted your hands on me since the photo booth
I noticed. You kept looking at my mouth
And you kept finding excuses to stand closer
Guilty
Good. Keep doing that. Under the blanket is fine

steps.title: HAK//NOTICE
messages: His palm slides over her ribs, then higher under the fabric
She shifts to straddle one of his thighs

steps.text: You're going to make it very difficult to be polite
I didn't invite you in for polite
Then I'm going to kiss you again
About time you stopped announcing it

steps.title: HAK//NOTICE
messages: Clothes stay on, hands do not stay still

steps.text: And for once, no question afterward
I was going to ask where to put my cup
Oh
Already on the table. Your other hand can stay where it is
What question were you expecting?
You know exactly which one
I'm not asking for a score
Good
I was enjoying that without one
That's a much better answer
I'll try not to ruin it
You could just sit here with me for a while. Hands included
Gladly
One quick picture before I put the phone away again?
With me in it?
Yes. I'd like to send it to him, like the one earlier
That's okay. No scoreboard this time?
No scoreboard. Just us looking like we weren't only drinking tea
Move a little closer or you're only going to be an ear
A MOMENT LATER
We brought the pastry back to mine and made tea. He said I could send you this one too
That's considerably less noise than the arcade
You have no idea. I've nearly got my hearing back. Other parts of me are less calm
You look happy
I am ❤️ We're going to leave the phones alone for a bit
Talk later
AFTER SHE PUTS HER PHONE AWAY
LATER THAT NIGHT
If I stay like this much longer I'm going to forget I meant to leave
That isn't an accident
Your shirt has ridden up
I noticed. You can keep your hand there
You're making it very hard to be the one who stands up first
Then kiss me once more and then stand up. I'm not taking you to bed tonight
I wasn't going to ask
You were thinking it. So was I. That's why I'm saying it now

steps.title: HAK//NOTICE
messages: One last deep kiss on the sofa
His hand at her waist, hers under the hem of his shirt

messages.speaker: player
messages.text: This is moving quickly, and I want us to keep talking honestly about what feels right.

steps.text: I liked tonight
The quieter part too?
Especially that part. Your mouth. Your hands. All of it
You can leave without trying to make a clever last remark, you know
I was going to say I'd like to see you again
You can keep that one
Message me tomorrow. We'll work something out
I will
And take the pastry box. If you leave it here, I'll end up eating the rest
A very difficult responsibility
Somehow I think you'll cope
AFTER HE LEAVES
He's gone home. We ended up staying on the sofa much longer than we'd planned
Tea was a successful idea, then
Very. We talked, sat close, and then I pulled him in
His hands were under my top. Mine were under his shirt. We kissed until I had to tell him we weren't going further tonight
He finally stopped asking whether he was doing better than you
That's a major breakthrough
Don't turn not competing into a competition 😭
I'm learning
It felt different tonight. Less like we were trying to work out what was supposed to happen
I wanted his hands on me, so I put them there. It didn't need another speech
You sound comfortable with that
I am. A little flushed. And I'm glad I had this afternoon with you as well
I'm on my own again. It was a lovely evening
You sound pleased
I am. Tired in a nice way, a bit warm still, and very glad I didn't spend my whole day watching the clock
Keep the details you want to keep. I'm glad you enjoyed yourself
Thank you. I still want a few minutes with you before I sleep ❤️
LATER THAT NIGHT
I finally put the app down 😌
Did you manage to read any of the book?
Some. Very little after we started talking about yesterday. Then even less after the photos
He told me he was looking for an excuse not to leave the bookshop. And that he wanted his hands on me properly
And you were trying to think of a reason to stay
Exactly. We seem to have sorted out that misunderstanding 😌❤️
The messages got much less cautious tonight
You didn't have to keep pretending you were only discussing the book?
No. I told him I wanted to see him again. And not only talk
And we sent each other a couple more photos. Then a couple that were less innocent
He agreed I could show you these two. The later ones stay between him and me
That's the smile that usually means you're pretending you haven't done anything
He noticed it too. Very inconvenient for me. The strap wasn't helping my case
And this is the one he took and sent back
You both look like you're enjoying the conversation
We were. Neither of us did much reading after that. I kept the last pictures for myself
The poor book
It will recover. I'm not sure I will before tomorrow
Was it easier talking in messages?
In some ways. I could think for a second without worrying that the silence looked strange
But I also caught myself wanting to hear how he'd say something, not just read it. And wanting his hands instead of another photo
That sounds like a reason for another date
It is. We'll talk tomorrow and choose a time
For tonight, I'm done changing between conversations
I'd like a little time with you before I sleep ❤️
I'm done messaging for tonight. I had a really nice evening
Did the book get much attention?
Not enough to pretend I've become a serious reader
I'll reserve judgment until you reach the next chapter
Thank you. I'm keeping the rest of the details for myself tonight
That's fine. How are you feeling?
Happy. A little too warm to sleep immediately. And ready to just talk to you for a minute ❤️
How was your evening after I left?
Quiet. I finished tidying up, then played for a while
Did you get stuck thinking again?
A little, but this afternoon helped more than sitting here trying to predict everything
We still argued about the film, you still stole my food. Nothing felt forced
It wasn't. I was exactly where I wanted to be
I know. You nearly fell asleep on me
That was a compliment to the sofa
Obviously
You sound like you've had a very good day
I have. Was yours all right after I left?
Yes. Quieter, but I liked having the afternoon with you
I keep remembering you trying to move my arm without admitting you wanted to lean on it
Your elbow was taking up a completely unreasonable amount of space
I'll arrange it more conveniently next time
Please do. I'm a demanding guest
I'm glad today wasn't just yesterday with different clothes
We should put that in the calendar. Occasionally do something else
You could even let me choose the next film without a formal appeal
Let's not get carried away
I love you, you know ❤️
I love you too
Now I'm going to get into bed before I start typing with my eyes closed
A FEW MINUTES LATER
Made it 😊 This one is just for you
That's my favorite end to the day
Seeing me finally stop talking?
Seeing you look happy
Oh. Now I have to be nice instead of making another joke
You can manage one message
Good night, handsome ❤️ Thank you for today
Good night. I'll keep your side of the sofa ready
And my spoon 😌 Don't forget my spoon
